{{Quote|A Neo-Cobral gang operating near Narmle is in tune with most of the underworld action happening in the area. Go convince them to reveal anything they might know about how to find Ponda Baba.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc|Tarc]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RHM" />}}
The '''Neo-Cobral Base''' was a bunker located a short distance west of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was controlled by the [[Neo-Cobral]].

==History==
[[File:NeoCobralBaseInterior.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cobrals inside their base]]
The base was controlled by the [[Neo-Cobral]],<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> a gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Black marketeer|dealers]] who once controlled the planet [[Frego]].<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with interrogating Cobrals at the base until one of them gave up information pertaining to an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal by the name of [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]].<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neo-Cobral Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Neo-Cobral Base was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
